title: Building Wealth 101
summary: Simple steps for new investors to get compounding working early.
author: BM Wealth Desk
content: Start with a clear emergency fund so investments can stay invested when markets move.
Automate monthly contributions and review asset allocation twice a year, not daily.
Keep fees low, avoid timing the market, and raise the SIP amount annually.

title: Risk Management Playbook
summary: How to decide between debt, equity, and hybrid exposure for your goals.
author: BM Wealth Desk
content: Match tenor of your goal to the product you choose; short goals belong in debt.
Use simple glide paths instead of complex products; clarity beats cleverness.
Diversify across issuers, sectors, and styles to avoid single-point failure.

title: Behavioral Checklist for Investors
summary: Tiny habits that protect long-term compounding from emotional decisions.
author: BM Wealth Desk
content: Decide actions in advance: what you will do if markets drop 20%?
Hide speculative money from your core portfolio; different goals, different rules.
Review performance versus a benchmark annually, not weekly.
